subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should this iOS preview-tour onboarding experience be adopted on top of the current main onboarding refresh, narrowed to a smaller follow-up, or paused/closed?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not only mechanical typography: current main has newer onboarding/routing/security-copy decisions, and this PR adds a new preview/sample mode with protected maintainer labeling.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, preserved configured-gateway routing, and fresh simulator proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to selected pieces
options.body: Extract only the still-wanted setup education or preview-data pieces into a smaller branch after maintainers choose the current onboarding baseline.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: Treat the current main onboarding refresh and focused follow-up PRs as the maintained direction if the preview-tour product surface is no longer wanted.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, preserved configured-gateway routing, and fresh simulator proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged current-main onboarding refresh is the strongest recent ownership signal for the overlapping product surface.
